name: weave_request_report
description: Requests a Weave report or gets the status of an existing report.

action.description: Use "request" to create a report. For "status", pass only action, the same reportType, and the returned reportId.

reportType.description: Report to request. Currently only credit_usage is supported.

startDate.description: First UTC calendar day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for all history.

endDate.description: Last UTC calendar day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Omit for today.

sendEmail.description: Email the requester’s account when ready. Defaults to false for polling; set true when the user asks for email.

reportId.description: The id returned when the report was requested.
